correctness.rationale: The proof derives block symmetry from global uniqueness, computes exact ellipsoid inclusion in both directions, reduces the full Löwner problem to maximizing strictly log-concave \(f(v)=v^p(1-v)^q(1-(1-t)v)\), solves the stationary quadratic and all endpoints, identifies all ridge contacts by equality conditions, verifies a positive two-layer contact design with zero mean and \(I_d/d\) covariance, and obtains strict monotonicity with sharp endpoint ratios. No sampling, finite search or external symbolic checker is used to prove a universal quantifier. Executing the bundled verifier passed 4791 exact symbolic and independent numerical checks.
